inputs.name: authentik_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/goauthentik/server image, such as "2026.8.5". Change image_digest with it. Upstream doesn't allow skipping a major release when you upgrade.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of ghcr.io/goauthentik/server for authentik_version. Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: public_url
inputs.description: The address people reach authentik at, such as "https://auth.example.com". authentik copies it to its Base URL setting on the first start, and leaves that setting alone afterwards.

inputs.name: postgres
inputs.type:
object({
    host     = optional(string, "127.0.0.1")
    port     = optional(number, 5432)
    database = optional(string, "authentik")
    username = optional(string, "authentik")
    sslmode  = optional(string, "disable")
  })
inputs.description: PostgreSQL 14 to 18 to keep authentik's data in. The database and role must exist. The defaults suit one on the same host, listening on localhost; set sslmode, such as "verify-ca", for one across a network.

inputs.name: postgres_password
inputs.description: Password of the postgres username, at most 99 characters. It reaches the host in root-only files and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: bootstrap_password
inputs.description: Password authentik gives akadmin on its first start. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state. authentik reads it only once, so set it to null after the first apply to take it off the host.

inputs.name: bootstrap_token
inputs.description: API token authentik creates for akadmin on its first start. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state. authentik reads it only once; set it to null after the first apply, and delete the token in authentik when you're done with it.

inputs.name: bootstrap_email
inputs.description: Email address authentik gives akadmin on its first start, such as "you@example.com".

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address the authentik server listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: Port the authentik server listens on for HTTP. 9001, 9300 and 9301 are taken by the circuit's other listeners.

inputs.name: https_port
inputs.description: Port the authentik server listens on for HTTPS, with its self-signed certificate until you give it another.

inputs.name: min_memory_mb
inputs.description: Memory, in MiB, a host needs before the circuit configures it. authentik asks for 2 GB; a 2 GB host reports less, as little as 1704 MiB on a Rocky Linux droplet.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: More of authentik's environment variables for the server and worker, such as { AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__HOST = "smtp.example.com" }. They go in root-only files and never reach the plan or state.
